meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Bilkul. India mein **men’s formal shirts** ke liye meri preference ye rahegi:

1. **Louis Philippe** — ⭐ Best premium choice  
   - Sophisticated, classy look
   - Office + meetings + formal occasions ke liye excellent
   - Sale mein ₹1,500–₹2,500 ke aas-paas mil jaye to strong buy. [www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Louis Philippe Men Shirt]()
*₹1,724*

2. **Van Heusen** — ⭐ Best overall/value  
   - Daily office wear ke liye meri **#1 practical choice**
   - Wrinkle-resistant/easy-care options bhi milte hain
   - Regular, slim aur doosre fits available hain. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Formal]()
*₹840*

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

### [Van Heusen Men's Solid Formal Shirt]()
*₹2,758*

3. **Arrow** — ⭐ Premium formal look  
   - Crisp, traditional corporate appearance
   - Important meetings/interviews ke liye particularly achha
   - Non-iron options bhi milte hain. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Raymond** — ⭐ Fabric + classic styling  
   - Classic, understated formal look
   - Premium fabric feel chahiye to good option. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Peter England** — ⭐ Budget-friendly  
   - Agar ₹800–₹1,500 range mein multiple office shirts leni hain, good value.
   - Daily rotation ke liye suitable. [www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

6. **Park Avenue** — ⭐ Affordable formal  
   - Clean, professional designs
   - Around ₹900–₹1,500 mein achhe options mil sakte hain. [www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar mujhe khud choose karna ho:
**₹1,000–1,500:** Van Heusen / Peter England  
**₹1,500–2,500:** **Louis Philippe / Van Heusen / Arrow**  
**₹2,500+:** Louis Philippe / Arrow / Raymond

Aur formal wardrobe ke liye pehle **white, light blue, light pink aur very subtle stripes** lo. Fit brand se bhi zyada important hai—shirt shoulders par properly baithni chahiye aur chest/waist par excessively tight nahi honi chahiye.

Agar tum **apna budget (₹1k, ₹2k, ₹3k etc.) aur body type (slim/normal/healthy)** bata do, main tumhare liye **5 best shirts specifically shortlist** kar deta hoon. 
